decision.classification: QA-only reversible fault-injection method change inside frozen M3 and Root-owned new-environment authorization.
decision.exactPurpose: Prove a necessary actual Lead UPDATE failure and a later decision-snapshot failure after the system fallback snapshot, without conflating FOR UPDATE privilege checks or ineffective midtransaction REVOKE with a measured write fault.
decision.earlierPrivilegeOnlyOrNoNewTriggerSugges: Superseded only for these targeted test methods by this named checkpoint and policy; originals remain unchanged. Expected atomicity/normal/no-op assertions are not weakened.

exactEnvironment.PG: Only the newly owned marked PG15 instance from this batch environment/authority receipts; verify database name/OID, instance/container/endpoint identity, namespace/run marker, original base and G1 baselineCommit by their distinct recorded fields.
exactEnvironment.preflight: All previous permission-revoke faults must already be restored. Verify original ACL/catalog state and no residual owned QA objects before arming a new case; no other Rust API/UI/fault writer in the fixture window.

objectOwnership.create: Use validated unique bounded identifiers and exact function signatures; reject preexisting names. No CREATE OR REPLACE, wildcard deletion or alteration of existing functions/triggers. Tables only poms.lead_score_snapshot or poms.lead.
objectOwnership.registry: Persist exact intended and created names/OIDs/signatures/owners/target relations/definition hashes and preinstallation catalog/ACL state in an append-only owned fixture ledger. Commit installation before the independent app request can see it.
objectOwnership.controlSchema: Prefer the existing owned tooling schema. If it must be created, separately record ownership/ACL and remove only the newly owned empty schema with RESTRICT after its objects are gone; never drop an existing schema.
objectOwnership.runtime: Explicit SECURITY INVOKER and fixed safe search_path/fully qualified relation names. current_user must remain the real app role, not a SECURITY DEFINER owner. No privilege escalation, extension, job, cross-database call or autonomous business/diagnostic table write.
objectOwnership.ACL: Do not widen app permissions. Any fixture-local function/schema ACL adjustment must be declared and restored exactly; no unrelated table/default ACL edits.

preciseTargets.provenance: Each target Lead UUID and override UUID is from this batch real HTTP producers and present in ownedIds and current PG graph; prepared legacy anomaly and its before/after preparation are separately labelled. Do not arm a seeded/unowned row.
preciseTargets.manualSnapshot: BEFORE INSERT on poms.lead_score_snapshot: AND current_user=poms_r3m_app, NEW.lead_id=the exact owned Lead, NEW.snapshot_kind=manual-override, and the expected override/source_record_id/source_command=approve-score-override. It must not reject system INSERT.
preciseTargets.revokedSnapshot: Separate declared case: snapshot_kind=override-revoked and source_command=revoke-score-override with the exact source_record_id of the revoked override. Current revoked snapshots have override_id null, so do not require a nonnull override_id that would make the predicate miss.
preciseTargets.lateProof: Before raising the intentional manual/revoked fault, the trigger function reads a newly inserted system snapshot visible in that same app transaction, with the same Lead and decision source_record_id; exclude all pre-request snapshot IDs. Capture its new ID and a unique case/run hit token in the diagnostic. An ordinary second connection cannot prove visibility of uncommitted rows.
preciseTargets.preconditionFailure: If that prior new system snapshot is absent or ambiguous, raise/report a different fixture-precondition marker. It is not the intended late fault and cannot count as a rollback acceptance pass.
preciseTargets.leadUpdate: BEFORE UPDATE on poms.lead: AND app role plus exact OLD/NEW owned Lead identity; reject actual row UPDATE only. SELECT/FOR UPDATE does not fire this row UPDATE trigger, so this can distinguish post-lock score DML from an early UPDATE-privilege failure.
preciseTargets.noLooseMatching: Keep every role/UUID/kind/source predicate conjunctive and explicit. No wildcard Lead scope, broad trigger for all app rows or blanket interception of arbitrary failures.

evidence.response: Require the existing normal API500 plus the captured unique database injection marker and declared P0001 diagnostic. If ordinary server logs omit SQLSTATE, the exact immutable function definition declaring P0001 plus its matching captured error marker/phase must establish it. No product API error-envelope modification.
evidence.incomplete: An arbitrary500, driver error, timeout, wrong target/role, precondition failure or200 is an injection miss/fixture error/partial, never a simulated necessary-write pass.
evidence.businessOracle: Immediately before and after the armed request, require both nonempty complete frozen business graphs, every required table array and actual target Lead/override rows. Exact graph comparison includes score/version/time/actor, old/new overrides, all snapshots, dependent rows and registered audits; session/business-managed fields versus independent auth upkeep and number reservations remain separately observed.
evidence.control: For the Lead UPDATE fixture, a normal matching-tuple decision must run on a target actually armed by the same predicate, succeed200 and leave its Lead row unchanged. A different unarmed UUID returning200 is not a valid no-UPDATE control. Do not use the intentionally failing manual-snapshot trigger as that200 control.
evidence.recovery: After exact fixture cleanup/restoration, a real successful retry on a valid still-pending/approved fixture must prove recovery. Preserve full source/artifact/DDL definitions/request/response/PG error/before-after/restoration evidence.
evidence.privacy: Original raw auth/SQL/error logs stay in current private storage with hashes; publish only declared bounded derivatives containing synthetic target IDs, marker/error/classification and source hashes. Do not read/copy old private.

cleanup.required: Finally after the app transaction ends, DROP only the exact registered trigger ON its exact table, then its exact function signature; no CASCADE. Validate ownership/name/OID/definition before touching an existing object so a reused or foreign object is not deleted.
cleanup.catalog: Compare pg_trigger/pg_proc sets and definitions/owners plus relevant namespace/table/function/schema/default ACL and seed state against the preinstallation baseline. Record fixture objects all absent, preexisting objects unchanged, complete graph/permission restoration and successful retry.
cleanup.interrupted: On next startup recover only the exact outstanding owned ledger objects before any new mutable test. Unexpected dependencies, incomplete cleanup or residual trigger/function/privilege changes block further mutable stages and G3/G4 until exact restoration is proven.
cleanup.truth: Record fixtureDDLExecuted=true and temporary catalog delta while armed; productMigrationsChanged=false/productDDLChanged=false is a separate statement only when accurate. Never report generic no-DDL for a run that created QA triggers/functions.

acceptedFixtureKinds: Exact owned Lead BEFORE UPDATE app-role DML failure
Exact owned Lead/override manual-override BEFORE INSERT after new same-TX system snapshot
Separately declared exact owned override-revoked BEFORE INSERT after new same-TX system snapshot

priorPartial18.RootReported: First seven observations completed; eighth late-REVOKE snapshot-injection attempt returned200 and committed a valid approval. Wholephase18 remainspartial/notpassed.
priorPartial18.interpretation: The attempted fault did not establish a necessary write failure. Successful200 business commit is not itself an atomicity defect; retain that committed graph and request as observed.
priorPartial18.newProof: Use a fresh valid owned fixture or transparently recorded owned preparation with a fresh immediate before graph. Do not silently rewind the successful approval or reuse an approved row as if it were stillpending.
